title: Tony Hawk's Underground 2
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Score, combo, special meter
Vicarious Visions' isometric THUG2: score, combo, special meter, goals per level
Get off the board (walking) to reach ledges, then hop back on to keep the combo going

Flip, grab, grind, manual, Freak Out
Unlockable trick sets from the ROM: lip transitions, grind transitions and flatland tricks
Stats include rail balance, lip balance and manual balance

World Destruction Tour goals per city
Level goals include score, combo, item and S-K-A-T-E style tasks; finishing them all is tracked ("All goals completed")

Cities of the World Destruction Tour
World Destruction Tour cities, played one after another

Stat points from goals
Cheats unlocked by play: always special, perfect balance (rail/manual/lip), moon physics, jet pack, matrix, turbo and mini modes

Hidden items per level
Secret skaters and cheats unlock as you complete goals

Goals and levels
Goals per level; all goals completed per city
